authorization_basis: Owner-requested precomputed background tables/interpolation acceleration; controller requested this finite contract. Existing goal/task/allocation accounting is retained.

authority.role: Read-only scientific/numerical authority except authoring this contract

implementation.rule: Lower-tier worker implements the complete contract; do not infer runtime identity from role name or self-description.

checkout.rule: Existing shared checkout only; preserve all dirty/untracked state. No clone/worktree/stash/reset/clean. Concurrent unrelated commits do not change pinned numerical source identity.

source_binding.relation: Historical/current difference is the reviewed additive output-allocation change, not permission for arbitrary source mismatch. Benchmark candidate is separately identified. Its sources are outside compiled_identity and require explicit hashes plus executable hash.

allowed_paths.rule: All implementation/evidence/build products remain in this new subtree or its exact remote counterpart; no existing source/config/contract/binary/checkpoint/dispatch/output is modified. Authority owns AUTHORITY_CONTRACT.json; worker may not amend its gates.

package.name: axbi_background_table_benchmark
package.dependency: Unchanged rust/rei_microphysics crate through local path ../../../../rust/rei_microphysics
package.standalone: Use an independent workspace root and separate CARGO_TARGET_DIR inside the allowed subtree. No edits to canonical Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, lib.rs or compiled_identity.

evidence_basis.repeated_work: point_at_scale repeats 4096-panel Simpson integration of elapsed clock and b for every query, including origin and repeated same-a calls. At GL8 the successful tentative path has approximately56 queries, approximately168 per full/two-half comparison before output; these are code counts, not timing measurements.
evidence_basis.source_emissivity: Spectral source quadrature is constructed once; at_redshift uses the frozen analytic formula. No source interpolation is authorized.
evidence_basis.live_original_rule: Do not signal/restart/attach profilers to or otherwise mutate original solver/observer processes. Capacity is rechecked before remote launch; original scheduler and shared science allocation are unchanged.

fixed_model.clock: elapsed proper seconds since zbar20; not absolute age
fixed_model.cosmology: Use exact Driver::new binary64 expressions from pinned source for h0,Omega_m,Omega_r,Omega_lambda.
fixed_model.same_h_rates: SameHDiagnostic uses H=H_FLRW; retain signed s and counterfactual label.

evaluators.direct: Pinned AxbiBackground::point_at_scale with4096 panels, unchanged reference.
evaluators.exact_cache: Per immutable background instance bounded cache keyed by exact a.to_bits(); maximum256 cached points, deterministic FIFO eviction. Cache only successful calls, preserve original validation/errors. Reuse exactly computed origin geometry and H_FLRW(a_ref) only without expression reassociation. All numerical outputs must match direct to_bits. No approximate keys or rounded scale factors.

table.coordinate: L=ln(a/a_ref); exact a endpoints explicitly stored
table.method: Piecewise cubic Hermite interpolation of t(L),b(L) only; direct4096-panel knot values; knot derivatives dt/dL=1/H,db/dL=s/H evaluated with the unchanged algebraic equations.
table.query: Return supplied a exactly. Evaluate H_FLRW,s,H,sigma algebraically; never independently interpolate them. Exact native knot hits return stored direct values. Exact endpoints return direct endpoint values. No extrapolation or clipping.
table.scope: This is a new numerical approximation to the prescribed background; it is not production adoption or an AX11 refinement result.

validation.sample_grid: For each case and each table resolution test both endpoints, all knots, and quarter/mid/three-quarter points of every cell. Cache/reuse direct reference values shared by the nested grids, outside timed direct benchmark sections, to honor the total direct-query cap.

point_gates.zero_shear: b=s=sigma exactly zero; t(aref)=0 and b(aref)=0 exactly.
point_gates.endpoints_and_exact_knots: Bitwise direct equality for t,b; supplied a preserved exactly.
point_gates.monotonicity: Finite positive H and strictly increasing clock; no negative/nonfinite physical-rate values where the direct evaluator is valid.
point_gates.signed_parity: H,t even under q sign; b,s odd under q sign at the same a; full radiation/chemistry scalar sign symmetry is not asserted.

derivative_gates.reference: Analytic1/H and s/H, at the same endpoint/knot/quarter-cell sample points; test one-sided derivatives at endpoints.

interval_samples.anchors: j/8 of full L range for j=0..8, choosing valid forward/backward intervals plus straddling the nearest table knot where valid; at most540 intervals across all cases. Do not query outside domain.
interval_samples.reference: Cancellation-resistant local composite Simpson integration of1/H over the small interval,32 and64 panels; both must agree to1e-9 relative. This is an empirical local-quadrature check, not an interval certificate.
interval_samples.table_integral: Compute the Hermite polynomial difference stably within cells and sum across cells; require positive increment and <=1e-9 relative discrepancy from64-panel local reference.
interval_samples.actual_driver_subtraction: Also report (interpolated_t2-interpolated_t1), direct4096_t2-direct4096_t1 and stable-table increments separately. Record relative cancellation error vs local reference. Any subtraction discrepancy >1e-8 relative is an explicit SHORT_STEP_SUBTRACTION_HOLD for production integration; it must not be hidden by the stable diagnostic or relaxed. Component timing may still complete within the fixed cap; no trajectory or integration is thereby authorized.

validation.domain_tests: Both endpoint exactness, out-of-domain and nonfinite query errors, positive clock increments, no extrapolation, exact-cache hit/miss/eviction equality. No point_at_time inversion benchmark is authorized in this unit.
validation.levels: Both1024 and2048 tables must independently satisfy component gates. Report their differences; no guaranteed convergence order or continuous supremum follows.
validation.gate_failure: First failed core invariant records raw failing coordinates/reference/candidate and stops numerical benchmark work. SHORT_STEP_SUBTRACTION_HOLD is a separately recorded integration limitation as specified above.

benchmark.query_lists: Deterministic identical direct/cache/table query lists: one repeated-a/ref pattern representing geometry/moment reuse, one unique-coordinate pattern over the domain. Store exact list construction/seeds or bits.
benchmark.accounting: All constructor/node/validation/timing direct calls count; use one cumulative counter. Predict quota before batch; no overflow attempt. Limits include local and remote benchmark executions; local tests must be accounted before reserving remote remainder.
benchmark.compiler: Consume outputs through std::hint::black_box and checksum to prevent elimination. Preserve query order and checksums across evaluators.
benchmark.interpretation: Measured component speedup on the same host only; no whole-driver speedup,64-core scaling,full-history accuracy,AX11/AX12 PASS or scientific admission.

limits.rule: Resource caps are cumulative for this unit under the existing goal; never reset goal/task/cost references. Candidate component tests are not baseline histories. Preserve any command that starts as charged work.

commands.binding: Before launch freeze exact argv/path/CPU/host/toolchain/executable and candidate-source hashes in RUN_BINDING.json; verify remote transferred hashes, available CPU,free disk and aggregate output reservation. Use observed available tools without inventing successful checks. Candidate parser implements these explicit flags.

stopping_and_transition.stop: Complete the fixed component matrix/timing repetitions or stop at first core invariant/resource/transport failure; preserve raw outcomes and cumulative counters. No automatic retries or grid enlargement.
stopping_and_transition.review: Fresh read-only Astra reviewer receives candidate source diff, immutable pins, raw tests/timings, first failures and receipts; it did not implement the candidate.
stopping_and_transition.pass_next_action: Component PASS permits the controller to request one narrowly scoped production exact-cache integration contract or interpolation-integration contract with applicable numerical checks. It does not itself authorize canonical source changes or a trajectory.
stopping_and_transition.hold_next_action: Return exact failed coordinate/identity/gate or missing input; independent baseline READY work continues under its existing allocation.
stopping_and_transition.AX11_AX12: Keep existing contracts/configs/dependencies and admission ceilings unchanged; no baseline rerun,live resume reinterpretation or new shared solver slot.
